pages.title: Anger
pages.text: Anger is a scorched and prickly wasteland, cut through by rivers of lava. It's so hot that the ground itself will burn you after a bit. If you can't get your hands on fire resistance, you might have to build bridges so your feet stay cool.

Anger is home to typhlotic blazes called $(bold)furies$(), the only typhlotic beasts who can attack from afar. But they will only attack if you have drawn a weapon first. Their definition of 'weapon' is expansive - anything with War spirits counts, even tools like axes.
